solver.solverDefinition: This solver uses backtracking and heuristic search to solve Sudoku problems.
solver.source: Bhattarai, Apekshya, Dinisha Uprety, Pooja Pathak, Safal Shrestha, Salina Narkarmi, and Sanjog Sigdel. 2025. “A Study of Sudoku Solving Algorithms: Backtracking and Heuristic.” Department of Computer Science, Kathmandu University.
